story_type: man in the water beside his capsized boat, response boat crew lines him in and hauls him aboard
hook: His boat flipped 12 miles out. He was in the water beside it.
narration: His boat flipped twelve miles out. He was in the water beside it.
The Vita Beata capsized off Miami in September 2020.
A Station Miami Beach crew got a line to him.
Their boat has a low rail, so the crew can reach the water.
[short pause] Then they hauled him aboard.
outcome: He was safe, and they took him ashore.

location_card.place: 12 miles east of Government Cut, Florida

title: Capsized 12 miles off Miami
description:
On Sept. 25, 2020, a Coast Guard Station Miami Beach 45-foot Response Boat-Medium crew rescued a man after his 25-foot pleasure craft, Vita Beata, capsized about 12 miles east of Government Cut, Florida.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Sonya Alcocer, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/767730/coast-guard-rescues-1-man-12-miles-east-government-cut

facts.claim: Station Miami Beach RB-M crew rescued a man after his 25-foot Vita Beata capsized 12 miles east of Government Cut, Sept. 25, 2020
facts.source_quote: A Coast Guard Station Miami Beach 45-foot Response Boat—Medium crew rescue a man after his 25-foot pleasure craft, Vita Beata, capsized approximately 12 miles east of Government Cut, Florida, Sept. 25, 2020.
The boat crew arrived on scene, safely embarked the man and took him ashore.
